pre_deployment_constants_regions.free-agent-board.html:
/* Pick values benchmarked against KeepTradeCut's real Superflex crowdsourced
   market (keeptradecut.com/dynasty-rankings, pulled 2026-08-13), anchored so
   "2027 early 1st" stays 7500 to match this tool's existing scale. The
   previous curve (round-over-round decay of ~40%/round) was badly out of
   step with the real market, which decays much more gently — a mid-4th
   trades for ~31% of a mid-1st in reality, not the ~7% the old curve implied.
   Rounds 5-6 aren't tracked individually on KTC and are extrapolated by
   continuing the observed R3→R4 decay rate; treat those two rows as a
   reasonable guess, not benchmarked fact. */
const PICK_BASE = {
  1: {early:7500, mid:5854, late:5244},
  2: {early:3906, mid:3624, late:3291},
  3: {early:2692, mid:2682, late:2319},
  4: {early:1972, mid:1831, late:1689},
  5: {early:1414, mid:1250, late:1118},  // extrapolated — no KTC data
  6: {early:1014, mid:853,  late:740},   // extrapolated — no KTC data
};
/* 2027→2028 discount benchmarked from real KTC data (avg ~0.85 across 12
   round/slot pairs, see chat history 2026-08-13). 2029 has no KTC market yet
   (picks that far out aren't tracked there) — extrapolated by compounding
   the same ~0.85 falloff once more (0.85² ≈ 0.72), not independently
   verified. Revisit once KTC starts listing 2029 picks. */
const YEAR_DISCOUNT = { '2027':1.0, '2028':0.85, '2029':0.72 };
